Bong bóng thoại / vật nhỏ hiện ra, nút b: Speech bubble / small object appears, a button pops — a short, round “pop”; the player uses it automatically when a bubble appears.
Vật lớn / người lao qua, chạy, xông lên,: Something big / someone rushes past, runs, charges, camera cut — a gust with a sliding pitch, panning left to right.
Bước chân nhẹ của nhân vật nhỏ (gót rồi: Light footsteps of a small character (heel then toe) — the player scatters them while walking; a slightly different take each time.
Sốc, hoảng, phát hiện điều động trời — h: Shock, panic, an earth-shattering discovery — two brass hits + timpani; an accent sound, put it on a step without dialogue.
Trúng đòn thường (đấm, đá, va) — đòn đán: A regular hit (punch, kick, bump) — attacks play it automatically on impact; set it by hand for head-bonking falls or bumping into things.
Nhảy bật, nảy, choáng váng, sao bay quan: Bouncing, springing, dizziness, stars around the head — an FM jaw harp, pitch shoots up then wobbles away.

Ăn mừng, reo hò, tiệc — pháo giấy nổ, kè: Celebration, cheering, a party — popper bang, party horn “peee”, falling tinsel, a cheerful run of bells.
Suy nghĩ, ngờ vực, dấu hỏi — hai nốt ngâ: Thinking, doubt, a question mark — two hummed kazoo-like notes, the second rising like a question.
Mở màn, thẻ tiêu đề, tuyên bố trọng đại: Opening, title card, a grand announcement — a long ringing gong with a slight pitch bend; long sound, only at the start / end of a shot.

Đỡ / chặn đòn bằng khiên, gậy, cánh tay: Blocking / stopping an attack with a shield, staff or arm — a thick wooden “thok” with a little metal.

Chạy biến, lao ra / vào khung hình trong: Vanishing at a run, darting in / out of frame in a flash — pitch shoots up, sliding to the right.
Lao vèo qua trước mặt (xe, ngựa, người c: Zooming past in front (a cart, a horse, someone super fast) — a roaring engine with a Doppler pitch shift, left to right.
Rón rén, lén lút, kẻ trộm nhón gót — dây: Tiptoeing, sneaking, a thief on tiptoe — plucked pizzicato strings creeping up and down by semitones + “tok” heel taps.

Rơi xuống, trượt ngã, xìu xuống — còi tr: Falling, slipping, deflating — a slide whistle dropping two octaves, wobbling as it goes.
Run lẩy bẩy, chân nhũn, rung như thạch,: Shaking all over, jelly legs, wobbling like jelly, tipsy — a rubbery wobble slowing down.
Choáng sau cú va — chim hót bay vòng qua: Dazed after a hit — birds tweeting as they circle the head (left → right → left) with sparkles.
Ngã bẹp, ăn bánh kem vào mặt, vật nhão r: Falling flat, a cream pie in the face, something mushy dropping — a wet “splat”, gooey wobble, droplets spraying.
Giẫm vỏ chuối, hụt chân — “vít” vọt lên: Stepping on a banana peel, missing a step — a “whip” rising + flailing feet; follow it with slide-down / nga-xuong.
Lộ âm mưu, sự thật động trời, kẻ xấu xuấ: A plot revealed, a shocking truth, the villain appears — three brass + drum notes, the last one trembling; long sound, start / end of a shot.
Loé ra ý tưởng, “à ra thế!”, bóng đèn bậ: A flash of insight, “aha!”, a light bulb over the head — one crystal-clear bell + sparkle.
Giật nảy người, tóc dựng đứng — tiếng rí: Jumping out of your skin, hair standing on end — a screech shooting up like a plucked string + a drum hit; shorter than sting.

Phải lòng, mắt hình trái tim, khen “đẹp: Falling in love, heart-shaped eyes, a “so gorgeous” compliment — a rising harp glide + a two-note wolf whistle.
Tức sôi máu, khói bốc lên đầu — xì hơi +: Boiling with anger, steam rising off the head — a hiss of steam + a trembling kettle whistle.
Không khí căng dần trước cao trào (đối m: Tension building before a climax (a face-off, a countdown) — a tremolo string rising, then cut off.
Nuốt nước bọt vì sợ / lo, cổ họng chạy l: Swallowing nervously out of fear / worry, throat bobbing — a falling “gulp” + a tiny “pop”.
Biến hình, hiện ra / biến mất trong làn: Transforming, appearing / vanishing in a puff of smoke — a smoke “poof” + a harp glide + sparkle.
Dịch chuyển tức thời, bị hút đi, chui và: Teleporting, being sucked away, stepping through a magic portal — a sparkly whoosh up, then “pop”.
Gồng mình tích lực, nạp năng lượng, sắp: Bracing and gathering power, charging up, about to unleash a special move — a rising arpeggio + a building hum.
Bắn tia phép / tia sáng, chưởng nhỏ — “p: Firing a magic bolt / beam, a small energy blast — a “pew” with a fast falling pitch.
Sấm sét (thật, hay “sét đánh ngang tai”: Thunder and lightning (real, or a “bolt from the blue” at bad news) — a crack, then a long deep rolling boom.
Cơn gió rít qua, cảnh hoang vắng / im ph: A gust howling past, a desolate / dead-silent scene, being blown away — a howling wind with a wavering pitch.
Rơi tõm xuống nước, té nước — “tùm” tụt: Falling into water with a splash — a falling “sploosh”, spray, bubbles rising.
Nồi sôi, dưới nước, ngâm mình, độc dược: A boiling pot, underwater, soaking, a bubbling potion — a string of “bloop” bubbles jumping in pitch.
Có người gõ cửa, gõ bàn đòi chú ý — ba t: Someone knocking at the door, rapping on the table for attention — three thick wooden knocks.
Cửa / sàn gỗ kẽo kẹt, mở cửa rón rén, cả: A creaking door / wooden floor, a door opened stealthily, a spooky scene — a notched grinding + wavering squeal.
Nhặt được xu / vật nhỏ, ghi điểm — hai n: Picking up a coin / small item, scoring — two cheerful game-style notes.
Đồng hồ báo thức, chuông reo gấp, hết gi: An alarm clock, an urgent bell, time's up — two brass bells struck rapidly by a small hammer.
Ra mắt hoành tráng, làm xong trò ảo thuậ: A grand entrance, a magic trick finished, success — two brass chords, the second ringing out.
Chốt câu đùa nhạt / câu chơi chữ — hai t: Landing a flat joke / pun — two toms “ba-dum” + snare and cymbal “TSS”; put it on the step AFTER the line.
Leo trèo, mọi thứ suôn sẻ, hớn hở đi lên: Climbing, everything going well, happily moving up — a fast xylophone run up an octave and a half.
Lăn lông lốc xuống cầu thang, đổ sụp, ho: Tumbling down the stairs, collapsing, seeing stars — a xylophone run down, slowing at the end.
Chìm vào giấc mơ, hồi tưởng, chuyển cảnh: Drifting into a dream, a flashback, a soft transition, gentle magic — a harp glide over two octaves.
